items.title: Apple's autocomplete restrictions include 'Dictator Trump' and 'Sleepy Joe,' researcher finds
items.summary: (Refiles to correct spelling in paragraph two to Derik, not Derek, removes extra word "said" in paragraph three)  WASHINGTON, Nov 6 (Reuters) - Apple has an undisclosed multilingual gray list of tens of thousands of words and phrases that its iOS keyboard will not autocomplete or swipe-type, a researcher said on Friday. iPhone users can still type what they like when drafting ‌emails and texts.
